label: Set
cue: Bar over midfoot; grip outside your shins.

label: Brace
cue: Brace your trunk; keep both arms straight.

label: Clear knees
cue: Drive up; keep the bar close.

label: Stand
cue: Stand tall; avoid leaning back or shrugging.

label: Control
cue: Hold your grip; control the return.

label: Lower
cue: Hinge back; guide the bar along legs.
